source_fields.title: Issue #455 R083: exclude invalid archived temperatures from next-shot and personal guidance [skip netlify]
source_fields.body:
## Scope and owner authority
Development-only SAFE existing-bounds data integrity repair under Issue #455 Option B. Source parent `a22dd810d1265d4a1c5804f3b3ca3f6e6131a198`, candidate `779873414c2e8a2cb51eba58cf686a1caa027fb5`. No Locked numeric target or scientific decision, provider/write/deployment/main/release/visibility change.

## Reproduced source defect
Existing `site/lib/engine.js::prefill` and `temperatureGuidance` accepted finite but out-of-bounds restored temperature observations, including newer 180 C prefill and successful historical 500 C personal recommendation. The already approved shot input limit in `site/lib/model.js::validateShot` and `CONFIG.bounds.tempC` is **70–100 C**. Malformed imported historical measurements are retained verbatim in History but must not seed current inputs/recommendations. No real member report or espresso quality claim.

## Scoped implementation
- One shared exact historical temperature eligibility gate; preserves valid endpoints, five taste ratings, same-style priority, original notes/history, existing temperature priors and all other recommendations.
- Seven isolated direct-module synthetic positive/negative/immutability regressions.
- SAME-COMMIT journal and TESTING release queue entry `DIC-Q-455-archived-temperature-evidence-integrity`.

## Gates
At authoring **CI UNEXECUTED**. Require risk-proportionate actual Node22/lint/build, browser/mobile/offline/a11y, SQL/security and governance checks, non-force exact-head merge and exact merged-source check before READY. Original603 is out of scope, skipped != passed. No deployment authorization.
